name: Almeida Electric
what_they_do: Licensed residential and commercial electrical contractor serving North Brunswick and the surrounding area since 2010, doing outlets/switches/fixtures, panel upgrades and rewiring, troubleshooting, generator installs and electrical work for additions and remodels. Publishes both NJ licence IDs on the site.
customers: Homeowners and small commercial clients in North Brunswick and nearby Middlesex County towns

size_signals.signal: 'Proudly serving North Brunswick, NJ and the surrounding area since 2010' plus 'over 10 years of experience'; no staff page
Two NJ licence IDs listed (Electrical Business Permit 34EB01696700, Electrical Contractor 34EI01696700) - licensed sole proprietor/small contractor
Google profile shows no street address, only a service area, consistent with a home-based or mobile contractor

website_review.primary_cta: 'Call Us Today! (732) 266-3639' and a 'Request a Call' nav item leading to a request form
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Request-service form with name, email, full address, two phone fields and a work description - but guarded by an image CAPTCHA ('type the letters shown above')
website_review.trust_signals: Two NJ licence IDs, 'since 2010', 10+ years experience, photos page, reviews page, 'Our Credentials' section
website_review.out_of_date_signs: The whole site is a HomeAdvisor WebSolutions template (copyright line credits 'HomeAdvisor WebSolutions'); no meta-keyword targeting beyond the town; the phone number is never a tel: link
website_review.search_basics: Title 'Almeida Electric | Electrical | North Brunswick, NJ' and a long service+town meta description; separate /services, /photos, /reviews, /request, /contact pages exist
top_issues: Zero tel: links anywhere - the phone number cannot be tapped on a phone
The only web form is behind a hard image CAPTCHA, so no customer agent (and many mobile users) can complete it
No schema markup at all and a template-built, thin site

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: Google profile exists with Electrician category, published hours (closed/opens 9 AM), correct phone and owner photos, but only 13 reviews and no street address - a service-area profile. robots.txt contains only AI content-signal commentary with no Disallow rules, so OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot/Googlebot are not blocked. Answerable: services, licence IDs and years are real text, but hours are not on the site and there is no JSON-LD of any kind. Bookable: the request form has labelled fields but requires solving an image CAPTCHA - a hard stop for any automated agent - and there is no scheduling.

operations_signals.signal: Every enquiry route ends in a phone call or a CAPTCHA-protected form, so the owner personally triages all inbound work
Reviews mention 'scheduling' as a theme (2 mentions in Google's review keyword summary), suggesting coordination effort is noticeable to customers
Only 13 Google reviews after 15 years of trading - no systematic review capture

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the CAPTCHA-guarded template form with a modern quote form (photos of the panel/outlet, job type, preferred times) plus auto-acknowledgement
top_opportunities.evidence: Request page requires typing letters from an image; the form is the only non-phone channel on the site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild on a current platform with click-to-call, LocalBusiness schema and per-service pages
top_opportunities.evidence: No tel: links, no JSON-LD, HomeAdvisor WebSolutions template branding in the footer

top_opportunities.opportunity: Automated review requests after each job to grow 13 reviews
top_opportunities.evidence: 15 years in business, licensed, yet only 13 Google reviews

scores.reasons: Gaps are stark (captcha-only intake, no click-to-call, no schema, template site) but this is a one-person licensed electrician with 13 reviews, so budget is the constraint; fixes are fast; all observed first-hand.
